description.en: An algal axis combines lower hair-like branched whorls with upper club-shaped unbranched laterals.
description.zh: 藻轴下部为毛状分枝轮，上部为棒状不分枝侧体。

scientific_scope.en: Fossil-specimen concept for Jimaodanus waukeshaensis, limited to the preserved organ or thallus described here; no complete parent organism is implied.
scientific_scope.zh: Jimaodanus waukeshaensis 的化石标本概念，仅限本文所述保存器官或叶状体，不暗示已知完整母体。

distinctness.en: Two anatomically different lateral zones provide a new silhouette beyond merely denser Chaetocladus whorls.
distinctness.zh: 两类不同侧枝区域形成新轮廓，而非仅更密的Chaetocladus轮枝。

modeling_brief.en: Separate the fine lower brush zone from a small crown of clavate lobes; do not give both zones the same instanced branch.
modeling_brief.zh: 把下部细刷区与上部棒瓣冠分开，不为两区使用同一种复制枝。

uncertainty: Heterocladus is the replaced preoccupied name; use the 2024 replacement Jimaodanus.
reference_notes: Planning record only. Source access labels distinguish opened pages from indexed abstracts/excerpts. Reference-ready is not a released model or a completed dimensional/rights audit.

sources.title: A new noncalcified dasycladalean alga from the Silurian of Wisconsin
sources.supports: Lower branched hair-like whorls and upper unbranched clavate laterals.

sources.title: Jimaodanus, a replacement name for the algal genus Heterocladus
sources.supports: 2024 replacement name and diagnostic two-zone branching morphology.
